scope: Q7 firmware provenance of FC1 control word at 0xb60000fc, including topology input typing, shared FC export and direct setter alternatives.
software_label: FC1 packed-control bit 0. In the applicable IPU pass-control branches, it is the stored topology-input-type-zero indicator.
physical_meaning: Unresolved. These code paths establish how the processor computes and writes the bit; the physical operation of the ISP datapath for each bit value is outside the evidence.

topology_type.constructor_argument: CFIP_PassTopology base constructor 0x8017c0e8 takes this typed enum as its sixth O32 argument and stores it to object+0x18.
topology_type.input_format_field: Topology object+0x50. The IPU constructor 0x8017c148 receives this separate typed format as its fifth O32 argument.
topology_type.binding: Topology params at object+0x84, with params+4 pointing to object+0x18. The cited top-control methods dereference that pointer as T.
topology_type.format_mutators: SetInputFormat 0x8017c304 changes +0x50. SetOutputFormat 0x8017c2f4 writes +0x44,+0x48,+0x4c. Both preserve the stored topology enum at +0x18 in this path.
topology_type.other_consumer: The 0x1 operation-mode routine 0x80178770 compares the same T with 2 to select local+0 as 0 when T==2 and 1 otherwise.
topology_type.inference: RGB_48 and YUV_444_16 share format 0xd/T1. RGB_10_12_10 format 0x16/T0 and YUV_422 format 2/T0 share T0. Thus neither T0 nor T1 alone identifies the RGB/YUV domain.

control_word.producer: 0x80176ec0 initializes the FC1/FC2/FC3/FC4 FC block modes to 1/2/3/4. The mode byte is stored at FC object+0x26 by 0x8017a974.
control_word.mode_1: 0x8017ab94 copies pass local+0x28 into FC block+0xc and zeroes +0xd. The 1x1 and 2x0 top-control methods and 0x1 with Q in {0,1,4} set local+0x28=(T==0). Remaining branch details are in control-followup.json.
control_word.shared_export: 0x8017ad04 writes the block output+0x2c as (u8[FC+0xc] & 1) | ((u8[FC+0xd] & 0xf) << 1). 0x801784c0 places FC1 at payload+0x100, making its packed word payload+0x12c.
control_word.other_modes: In the shared ConfigIntRegs routine, modes 2 and 4 set FC+0xc=1 and +0xd=0 independently of topology and select YUV2RGB presets. Mode 3 sets bit 0 when local+0x29 bit 0 is set and (u8[local+0x29] >> 1) != 1, copies local+0x65 into FC+0xd, and selects local+0x6c custom coefficients or fallback presets. These are software construction paths for separate FC blocks.
control_word.matrix_independence: Existing coefficient replay hdr-custom-flag0/1 exports the same eleven values for both flag values in FC1 mode 1. The new descriptor replay holds each version-specific coefficient/tail result constant while toggling control bit 0.
control_word.enable_independence: FC1 active-low enable/bypass has its own word at 0xb60000ec (fc1-enable-checks.json). The FC1 coefficient writer reads object+0x48 as one full word for 0xb60000fc.

fresh_hdr.note: Location 10 has T0 and uses the 5x1 base method which forces flag zero. The final submitted pass is index 3, location 5, class 0x1 with Q0/T1, also yielding flag zero.

replay.scope: Original MIPS image-type name and input-format mapping, IPU topology constructor and format setters, and FC1 constructor, descriptor dispatcher and direct writer. Synthetic objects and RAM MMIO with no stubs. No scheduling, camera or ISP datapath execution.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
limitations: Function ranges are next-sidecar intervals. The actual upper descriptor switch targets include local bodies beyond the dispatcher sidecar interval. Version table words and concrete replay cover those transfers.

Names in this report refer to the recovered firmware types and functions. No named enum members for fiplib_pass_input_type or named bit-field in the physical register were recovered in the selected evidence.
VEX cases run in synthetic RAM. MMIO is recorded as ordered stores, and camera silicon, pixel data, scheduling and actual hardware effects are outside the replay.
Related blocks use the same software packing function. Their register offsets and control-word propagation do not establish equivalent bit behavior in silicon.
